Specsight: Product observability for teams shipping fast with AI [...] ## What does Specsight actually do?

Specsight connects to your repositories, runs a full codebase scan on setup, then syncs only what changed on each release, triaging out irrelevant merges. Founder Ola Piętka describes the approach in the Show HN launch thread: the system reads code with the Claude Agent SDK, extracts business-level features, writes Context/Action/Outcome specifications and a visual graph of feature connections.

Ola Piętka

📌 [...] So I built Specsight.  
  
It tracks your product as it evolves, straight from the source code. It shows what features exist, how they behave, how they connect, and what changed with every release, all in plain product language.  
  
Unlike release notes that only tell you what's new, Specsight maintains a living understanding of your entire product, so Product, Sales, and Support can keep up without constantly chasing engineering.  
  
What changes for your team:  
- Support knows what changed and how things work before customers start asking.  
- Sales demos the product as it works today, not as it worked last month.  
- Product sees what actually got built, not just what was planned.  
- "Let me check with engineering" becomes an answer in seconds.
